content: Esus uincuente
Adashic, sabado inchëshbudtsëqui seis yanuc chonoadtemaid ushë naimëdan badiadnuc danoshcanun ambi nacnemboed buanec Esus nauedbocno isec chidobo nidpanëdash.
Ambo choshon Esus nauedshun bëtashaid cuënote shëcniacsho isashi
shëcuën puduedash aton Icbo Esusën dada nibëdsho isec tabadpanëdash.
Adec tabadnubien dada daëd dashcute dasiuidacbimboec dasiuidash chënquec chopanëdash.
Aid isash dacuëdcuededequi isenquio yec chidobo tabadpanëdash. Adsho isash dada daëd: —¿Atotsi canuen unësacsho nauedac uincuemiaid nibëne?
Nëmbo nauedboedi nibëdec. Aidi uincuenaccosh. ¿Aidi Cadidia yacno mibëdi tabadquin chuisho tantienquioda icco?

Naden Esusën mibitedi chiondash: “Matsesaid ëbi icsho bedshun icsambocquid ëbi menendac. Aden meniac cuesten dectanac daëdec ushtanec uincuenoaibi,” quequin Esusën chiondash —quepanëdash dada daëd chidobo caic.
Aden chiac chidobon Esusën chiaid abi bëpiscudaid padpiden tantiapanëdash.
Aden tantiash Esus nauedaid shëcuë yacnoësh puduenanec Esus tantiaquid dadpen tabadacno choec puduedshun ambi isboedbëdtabi ambi tantiaboed chidobon chuibampanëdash.
Madia shubu dadpen icquid Mactada caid yacnoshon tishaid yec Uana yec Madia utsi Uambëdtan Acobon tita yec chido utsibo yec quec choshon Esusën Ëbi chuibeneta caido chuipanëdash.
Aden chuisho tantiash: —Mimbi chiaid tantiatiapimbo iquebi —quecuededpanëdash iccuededquido.

Adnubien Petedo nidtoanec titinquec nauedaid shëcuë yacno choash shuebudquin shëcuë anisquin dataniaid dashcuteuidi uesho ispanëdash. Aden isanec nidequi: —¿Atodain nechitec? —quepanëdash Petedo tantienquio yec.
Emaus yacmi nidte
Adashic abi ushëmbi Edusaden yacnoësh utsibobëd iccuededboed dada daëd shubu daëdpactsëc icquid Emaus caid yacno nidpanëdash.
Adec nidequi ambi Edusaden yacnoshon isboedbëdta ambi tantiaboed chiec onquepanëdash.
Aden chiec onquec nidshobi Esusën aid daëdi chinunash aidobëd nidpanëdash.
Aden abi chinuntuidsho isac utsibimboec Esus isadpanëdash.
Adec nidequi Esus: —¿Atotsi chuibanec onquec nide? —quepanëdash. Adsho tantiash unësquio yec mamënenquio yec nidtuidpanëdash.
Adec nidtuidash Quëdeyopas cuëmëdquid: —¿Edusaden yacno tabadtuidquin anoshon naboed mimbiuidtsëqui tantiamboda icco? —quepanëdash Esus caic.

Adoaquien: —¿Atotsi naid chiec ne? —quepanëdash Esus. Adoaquien: —Esus Nasaded yacnoësh choquid chiec nebi. Aidi Nuquin Papan ambi chiaid chuimiaid icquin ambi chuibaniaid ambi nabanaidbidi Nuquin Papabëdtan matses dadpenshun bëdamboen isaid icposh.
Nuquin tsusio dapabobëdtan nuqui chuiquid utsibon Esus bedshun: “Unës uata,” quequin isadaidpembo chuiquid meniac cuesten dectanquin unës uaposh.
Nëbi chuiquid dapa isadaidpembo iquenquiocpashun, quequin Esus isadaidbo yec isadaidbo chuiquid dapa ictsiash quequin ëbitedishun tantiapombi. Ëmbi caboedi unës uaposh. Aidi unës uan daëdec ushobi.
Adec daëdec ushun dacuëdanquiecnuc chidobon naden chuibededposh: “Esusën dada nauedbocno badiadnuc nidshun isac
nibëdosh. Ambobi icnubi Nuquin Papan uaido mayan bëdabo daëd icsho isac, ‘Mimbi nibënaid nibëdec. Uincuenac,’ quiosh,” quequin chidobon chuiposh.
Aden chidobon chuisho tantienquio yec ëbëd icquido Esusën dada nauedbocno nidshun chidobon chuibocpadembi unës uaboed nibëdsho isposh —quepanëdash ambi chinunaido Esus chiec.
Adoaquien: —Ma bëdiactsëc tantiaquid mibi daëdi neyoc. Nuquin Papan ambi chiaid chuimiaidon dada uampid bëdiactsëc tantiatsec tantiesabidi ma mibi neyoc.
¿Bëdamboec tabadacno chuiquid dapa icnuec Esus mëyanaidba iquendactiosh? —quepanëdash Esus.
Aden chuibanquin Moisesën dada uampidbëdtabi Nuquin Papan ambi yuecshun nanun chiaid chuimiaidon dada uampid tantiamequin Esusën chuibampanëdash.
Aden chuibanequi shubu daëdpactsëc icquid Emaus caid yacno anoentsëqui choshon datanshobimboecnuc Esus isun:
—Inchësheque. Nëmbo ëbi yacno tabadec cho —abi daëdshun cac nidash aidobëd tabadpanëdash.
Adashic, shubu nuntan pete sante dayun abëdi uequin pete bedshun Nuquin Papa chuishun cuësh-cuëshun Esusën menebampanëdash.
Aden nasho isun badedi, Esus nec, quequin tantianubi Esus nibëdquio yampanëdash.
Adsho isash: —¿Podquedën choquin Nuquin Papan chiaid dada uampid chuisho tantiash, Bëdambo yanobi, quenquiodabi ëbi daëdi ictio? —quepanëdash Esus yuedquido.
Aden chuitanequi Emaus yacno choboed daëd badedi Edusaden yacno nidoapanëdash. Edusaden yacno choash Esusbëd icquido 11tedbëdi utsibo iccuededacno puduedacsho isash:
—Abimbo iquec. Nuquin Icbo uincuempaccosh. Uincuenanec choquin aidëmbi Simon ismetuidposh —quepanëdash iccuededquido.
Aden iccuededquidon chuisho tantiashun Emaus yacnoësh choaboed daëdshun Esusën abi chinunshun chiaidbëdta ambi pete bedshun Esusën cuësh-cuëshbamboed chuipanëdash.
Abëd icboedo yacno Esus chote
Adec onquecuedednubi nënantanquio choshon Esusën: —Nuquin Papan bëdamboen isaido yec dacuëdenquio yec tabad —capanëdash.
Adec aid chosho isash: Podo bitsi nec, quec dacuëdequi abëd icquido tabadpanëdash.
Adsho isashien Esus: —¿Atotsi quiash, ¿Esusida nepec? mibitedi quepe?
Con mëdantebëdta con taë is. Ëbibi nebique. ¿Mëtoccaid taëbëd chiuë nibëdecta ye? Mishec cho. Ëbi yacpadquid canitebëd nami icquid podobitsi nibëdec —quepanëdash Esus abëd icquido chiec.
Aden chuitanquin abi bëchun shuin mëtoccaid chiuë aton mëdantebëdta aton taë Esusën ismepanëdash.

Aden ismiac, Aidquiobi nec, quenquio yec abëd icquido mamëncuededquin isec bëdambo yanec, Adec uincuentequidshenda dectampaccosh, quequin tantiec tabadpanëdash. Adec tabadsho isun: —¿Ada pete iquec? —Esusën caquien
nuëcquid shëaid cuëshë menepanëdash.
Aden meniac bedshun Esusën pepanëdash abëd icquidon isnubi.

Aden piash: —Mibëd icquimbi naden chuipombi: “Nuquin Papan ëbi chuiquin ambi naden nata quequin Moises dada uamiampidbëdta ambi yuecshun nanun chiaid dada uamiampid naimbudtenendac,” quequin chuibanombi —quepanëdash abëd icquido tantiamenuec.
Aden chuishumbic abëd icquido tantiamequioquin:
—Nuquin Papan dada uamiampid nad iquec: “Nuquin Papan chomiaid, Quidistu caid, matsesën mëyanquin unës uaqui daëdec ushash uincuenendac.

Aid tantiashun mibi icsaid mimbi ënsho isash, Icsaquid nec, quenquio yec mibi icsaid Nuquin Papa bëpiscudendac, quequin Edusaden yacnocquidoba ëbi tantiaquidon chuibanendac. Aden Edusaden yacnocquido chuishumbic nidaid utsi-utsiec yacno nidshun adomboembidi chuibanoaindac.
Mëyanquin unës uaqui ëbi uincuenacsho mibitedishun ispoc.

Aden isun tantiaquido mibitedi icsho Nuquin Papan ambi mibitedi menenu caid aton Mayan chomendambi. Aidi Nuquin Papan nadatiambocquin natequid iquec. Aid mibitedi meniabicnuc Edusaden yacnoshon aidi caimbudta,” —capanëdash Esusën.
Esus abuc indote
Adashic, bëyucanec nidequi Betania yacno anoentsëqui choash nidtuidshun aton mëdante abuc sananquin ismec: —Nëidtedi bëdamboen ista, Papa —quepanëdash Esus.
Aden chiacsho abëd capucuenequido niamequin Esus aton Papan abuc indopanëdash.
Aden indosho isash, Ëbitedishun icbo nec, quequin ismec shuebudash: —Bëdambo iquebi —quianec Edusaden yacno nidanepanëdash.
Adec Edusaden yacno nidoash tabadec Nuquin Papa tabadte shubu uashunaid yacno badiadquidën-badiadquidënquiec nidted-nidtedquin Nuquin Papan naid chuidenepanëdash. Padi. Aidted dada uaombi, Teyopido.
